purpose: Source-backed cross-paper FigureAST generalization experiment. FigureSpecs are editable scholarly redraws; the original PDF remains the scientific source. Render parity is experimental evidence, not a release gate.

policy.core_gate: FigureAST semantic round-trip, supported primitives, and source/asset hash binding are hard validation requirements.
policy.rendered_parity: Legacy-versus-AST DrawingML/SVG/LibreOffice parity is a non-blocking research experiment. Every result, including failures, must be retained for review.
policy.no_pixel_identity_claim: A source-visible redraw is not automatically pixel-identical to the original paper artwork.
